summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, a routine capital-markets disclosure) announcing the issuance of R$5.0 billion of Tier 2 Subordinated Financial Bills placed with professional investors. The notes mature in 2036 and 2037, with a repurchase option from 2031 subject to Central Bank of Brazil authorization. Proceeds count toward Tier 2 Capital under BCB Resolutions 122 and 5,007, adding an estimated 30 basis points to the Tier 2 capital ratio, calculated against the June 30, 2026 capital base. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or stake is stated; this is ordinary regulatory capital funding rather than a special situation, with no equity-arbitrage angle.
